summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are out jogging when they are attracted to a scene of a murder. One of the owners of the Ojamanbou Cleaning Company has been killed by a falling beam. Location: Alleyway adjacent to the Ojamanbou Cleaning Company building Victim: Tsunehisa Fujii Cause of death: Blunt force trauma from the falling steel beam Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are out jogging when they are attracted to a scene of a murder. One of the owners of the Ojamanbou Cleaning Company has been killed by a falling beam. Location: Construction site Victim: Kumiko Nakayama Cause of death: Blunt force trauma from the falling steel beam According to Kuniko, Hideyuki's sister Kumiko became a part-time construction worker after she quits from the Ojamanbou Cleaning Company following her arguement with her brother. However while she was in a middle of her job, she died from getting crushed by a falling steel beam.
